content:
Earlier this year, we learned that Volvo intends to support features such as Apple Music's Spatial Audio through a CarPlay update. Volvo has today once again confirmed that support, and announced the detailed availability of this audio upgrade.

In January this year, Volvo pledged to continue supporting Apple CarPlay, even as some carmakers such as GM have pulled support from certain models. At that time we also mentioned that the Volvo EX60 SUV would support Spatial Audio via CarPlay.

Volvo today announced new details regarding the Spatial Audio feature, specifically for the EX90 model:

The latest software update also brings Spatial Audio support for CarPlay* to the Volvo EX90, using Dolby Atmos technology. With the premium Bowers & Wilkins sound system, which includes 25 high-performance speakers, Volvo drivers can enjoy a multi-dimensional, immersive sound experience that envelops the cabin with music and vocals. From favourite tracks and live performances to podcasts, Spatial Audio powered by Dolby Atmos adds layers and detail to everything you listen to—making every drive richer, more engaging, and more enjoyable.

Volvo added: "Spatial Audio on CarPlay requires the Bowers & Wilkins sound system for the full immersive experience, and it can be optioned in when buying a Volvo EX60, EX90 and ES90."

Not planning to buy a new car? Pioneer earlier this year launched the first aftermarket CarPlay system on the market to support Dolby Atmos Spatial Audio playback.
